title: Queensland stays out of automatic mutual recognition
summary: Queensland reserved the right to veto AMR provisions (December 2020) and has not entered the scheme, so interstate workers still need standard mutual recognition applications in Queensland and vice versa.

instruments.title: Mutual Recognition (Queensland) Act 1992
instruments.provisions: No adoption of the 2021 AMR amendments

direction_rationale: No change in Queensland law: relative to adopting states, Queensland keeps existing application-and-fee barriers, so it serves as the untreated comparison group rather than a treatment.
comparison: Queensland is itself the never-treated control for the AMR family
price_series: Maintenance and repair of the dwelling; Real estate services are not a separate CPI class

assessment.summary: Queensland stays out of automatic mutual recognition, so licensed workers moving into or out of the state still apply and pay for a separate registration.

marks.reason: Keeps the application and fee licensed workers face when moving between Queensland and other states.
